technical.summary: KMI shows long-term uptrend structure with price above key moving averages, but lacks directional momentum (low ADX), has overbought stochastic conditions, and weak short-term confluence—moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: KMI shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 20 days adds timing risk with no fundamental catalysts evident.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (35/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed with no clear conviction signal; neutral overall sentiment with slight bullish lean from fear extremity.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (226), and earnings binary event in 20 days create compounded downside risk; falling DXY provides minimal offset for energy sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with supertrend bullish and contrarian buy signal from fear-zone extremity (VIX 226) offers asymmetric risk/reward for patient swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary event in 20 days combined with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX, zero momentum (ADX false, AO negative), overbought stochastic, and weak short-term structure create compounded downside risk that outweighs long-term structure.

decision.entry_rationale: While price structure above 200-EMA and contrarian fear-zone signal offer theoretical appeal, the combination of earnings binary event (20 days), crisis-level VIX, inverted yield curve, and zero momentum (ADX false, AO negative) creates asymmetric downside risk that outweighs long-term bullish structure.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement within 20 days combined with macro recession signals (inverted yield curve, VIX 226) creates binary event risk with weak technical momentum to support recovery.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, risk, and debate agents all converge on bear case; only sentiment offers weak contrarian offset
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 17 Energy positions and existing KMI position; sector concentration and earnings proximity warrant avoidance rather than addition.
